title: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Boil salted water and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Crisp the guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat.
Whisk yolks with cheese and plenty of black pepper.
Toss hot pasta with guanciale off the heat, then add the egg mix and a splash of pasta water. Stir until creamy.
Serve immediately with extra pecorino on top.

title: Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza stone inside.
Stretch the dough into a round on a floured surface.
Spread the crushed tomatoes, season with salt, and tear mozzarella over the top.
Bake for 6-8 minutes until the crust is blistered and the cheese melts.
Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Classic Lasagne
steps: Brown the beef with onion and garlic, then add tomato sauce and simmer.
Make the bechamel: butter, flour, milk, salt, nutmeg.
Layer pasta, meat sauce, bechamel, and parmesan in a baking dish.
Repeat layers and finish with bechamel and parmesan.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling.

title: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl.
Whisk egg and milk together, then fold into the dry mix until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a little butter.
Pour ladlefuls of batter and cook until bubbles appear, then flip.
Serve stacked with butter and maple syrup.

title: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in a splash of coconut milk until fragrant.
Add chicken and stir until coated and starting to cook.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and a pinch of brown sugar.
Stir in basil leaves and serve over jasmine rice.

title: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate and butter together over a double boiler.
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale and fluffy.
Fold the chocolate mix into the eggs, then sift in flour and salt.
Pour into a lined tin and bake at 170°C for 25-30 minutes.
Cool before slicing into squares.
